_doc: CRITICALITY-1 invariant (Rowan, 2026-11-13). foundation/criticality.py computes k every tick and gates the executor queue; the mantra's four clauses are each a computed check. Items labeled ignition (Q-DOER, Q-METRIC from foundation/sauce.py) close a link of the chain and pass the gate.

self_reference._doc: SELF-REFERENCE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-14): 'Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable. That self-reference is key to bootstrapping and criticality.' A verified deploy counts toward k_self only when the system originated and executed the work on itself (its executor or its own server-side code agent). Deploys driven by an outside session are an external neutron source: they raise k, never k_self. bootstrap is the fixed point: the bootstrap that boots any system boots Ultrastable from this repository (foundation.selfhost.verify). Regime: self-sustaining (bootstrap holds and k_self >= k_floor), driven (k >= k_floor but k_self below it), subcritical (k < k_floor).
